scripts.dev: pnpm prepare:compositions && cd projects/landscape && hyperframes preview --port 4406 --no-open
scripts.dev:portrait: pnpm prepare:compositions && cd projects/portrait && hyperframes preview --port 4407 --no-open
scripts.lint:composition: pnpm prepare:compositions && cd projects/landscape && hyperframes lint && cd ../portrait && hyperframes lint
scripts.validate: pnpm prepare:compositions && cd projects/landscape && hyperframes check && cd ../portrait && hyperframes check
scripts.render:landscape: pnpm prepare:compositions && cd projects/landscape && hyperframes render --quality high --fps 30 --output ../../output/living-signals-landscape.mp4
scripts.render:portrait: pnpm prepare:compositions && cd projects/portrait && hyperframes render --quality high --fps 30 --output ../../output/living-signals-portrait.mp4
